question: Group all rooms into whether or not they are assignable and the major use descriptions. For each group, state "ASSIGNABLE" if the room is assignable and "NON-ASSIGNABLE" otherwise, the major use description, the total number of rooms, total area, and average area. Include subtotals for each group and a grand total across all groups. The assignable status and major use descriptions should only be displayed when they differ from the previous row. Do not include rooms whose major use or major use description starts with 'ZUSE.' The results should be sorted by assignable status and major use description. The subtotal and grand total rows should not include assignable status or major use description.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "rooms_with_use" AS SELECT "fclt_room_key" AS "fclt_room_key", "major_use_desc" AS "major_use_desc", "area" AS "area", "fclt_major_use_key" AS "fclt_major_use_key" FROM beaver."fclt_rooms";
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "major_use_lookup" AS SELECT "fclt_major_use_key" AS "fclt_major_use_key", "assignable" AS "assignable", "description" AS "description" FROM beaver."fclt_major_use";
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS 
WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    mu.assignable AS assignable,
    r.major_use_desc AS major_use_description,
    COUNT(*) AS room_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(r.area),0) AS total_area,
    AVG(r.area) AS avg_area
  FROM rooms_with_use r
  JOIN major_use_lookup mu
    ON CAST(r.fclt_major_use_key AS BIGINT)=CAST(mu.fclt_major_use_key AS BIGINT)
  WHERE r.major_use_desc IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT (r.major_use_desc ILIKE 'ZUSE.%')
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
-- Subtotals by assignable only
assignable_sub AS (
  SELECT 
    assignable,
    NULL::VARCHAR AS major_use_description,
    SUM(room_count) AS room_count,
    SUM(total_area) AS total_area,
    CASE WHEN SUM(room_count)>0 THEN SUM(total_area)/SUM(room_count) ELSE NULL END AS avg_area,
    1 AS is_subtotal,
    0 AS is_grand
  FROM base
  GROUP BY assignable
),
-- Grand total
grand AS (
  SELECT 
    NULL::BIGINT AS assignable,
    NULL::VARCHAR AS major_use_description,
    SUM(room_count) AS room_count,
    SUM(total_area) AS total_area,
    CASE WHEN SUM(room_count)>0 THEN SUM(total_area)/SUM(room_count) ELSE NULL END AS avg_area,
    0 AS is_subtotal,
    1 AS is_grand
  FROM base
),
-- Detail rows
detail AS (
  SELECT 
    assignable,
    major_use_description,
    room_count,
    total_area,
    avg_area,
    0 AS is_subtotal,
    0 AS is_grand
  FROM base
)
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN is_grand=1 OR is_subtotal=1 THEN NULL
    WHEN assignable=1 THEN 'ASSIGNABLE'
    WHEN assignable=0 THEN 'NON-ASSIGNABLE'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS assignable_status,
  major_use_description,
  room_count,
  total_area,
  avg_area,
  is_subtotal,
  is_grand,
  assignable,
  major_use_description AS sort_mud
FROM detail
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  NULL AS assignable_status,
  NULL AS major_use_description,
  room_count,
  total_area,
  avg_area,
  is_subtotal,
  is_grand,
  assignable,
  NULL AS sort_mud
FROM assignable_sub
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  NULL AS assignable_status,
  NULL AS major_use_description,
  room_count,
  total_area,
  avg_area,
  is_subtotal,
  is_grand,
  NULL AS assignable,
  NULL AS sort_mud
FROM grand
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN assignable IS NULL THEN 2 ELSE assignable END, 
  sort_mud NULLS LAST,
  is_grand,
  is_subtotal
